tasks.title: Expire links at 0 points and remove them remove_days later
steps: Add the expiry and removal behaviours to src/worker/decay/decay.test.ts and confirm they fail

Replace the evaluation's dormancy, sticky and archiving statements with one statement that expires every active, pending or unreachable link of the user with points 0 or below at the evaluation time, not pinned and in no workspace, setting expired_at; the statement carries its own conditions so a link used meanwhile is left as the use left it

Make the removal statements select expired links that are neither pinned nor in a workspace with expired_at at least remove_days before the evaluation time; keep the single transaction, last_decay_at and the deletion of stored objects after it
Give every link view removal_at = expired_at + remove_days for an expired link and null otherwise
Remove STICKY and its uses; describe the rules in docs/architecture.md
